notes: A dark navy left panel carries the HG Insights logo, the headline 'Your Agents are only as good as the data behind them', two statistic cards and an executive quote. The right cream panel is headed 'Welcome to HG Insights' and splits sign-in into two cards: 'Sign in with OAuth' (Continue with Google and Microsoft) and 'Sign in with Email' (email and password fields with a reveal toggle and Forgot password). A Sign up link closes the page. The marketing panel takes half the screen and the page does not name the requesting app or show permissions.
